description: Start one bounded independent investigation, analysis, implementation, or verification task when delegation offers a useful benefit. Give a clear goal, context, scope, expected result, and stopping condition. Simple or context-dependent work can be done directly. Use inspect for read-only work; implement permits writes and shell commands only within authorized scope. The supervisor retains global decisions and final review. A failed implement worker may leave partial edits. Success means accepted, not completed.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory inside PI_WORKER_ALLOWED_ROOTS. The worker runs in exactly this directory.

model.description: Optional model override for this worker only. When omitted, Pi chooses its locally configured default. The value must resolve to a model available in this worker's local Pi environment.

profile.description: inspect is read-only and may share a checkout; implement can write files.

task.description: One bounded task with a clear scope and expected result.

thinking.description: Optional reasoning level for this worker only. When omitted, Pi keeps its configured default. Must be supported by the active model; an unsupported level is reported instead of being silently ignored.

name: pi_spawn
